tools.name: find_videos
tools.description: Search Into the Prompt's short practical AI videos (prompting, using AI responsibly, studying with AI, and RAG: how AI answers from your own documents) for a topic or question, in the person's own words. Returns matching videos with a one-line summary and a link that opens each one on the Into the Prompt map. Give the map link first: progress is recorded on the map.

query.description: What the person wants to learn, in their words

tools.name: learning_path
tools.description: Suggest a short, ordered list of Into the Prompt videos for a goal or a person, such as "I'm a student new to AI", "I'm a teacher", "I run a small business" or "I want to use AI at work". Without a goal it returns the beginner route. Someone who wants to make videos for Into the Prompt is pointed to creator_program instead.

tools.name: list_series
tools.description: List every live Into the Prompt video series: what it teaches, where it sits on the map, and how many videos it has.

tools.name: creator_program
tools.description: How the Into the Prompt Community Creator Program works: each ITP Trainer owns a whole Series of 10 to 30 short videos, the four types of Series, the pay per approved video, how to record, the seven steps from applying to being paid, and where to apply.

tools.name: open_topics
tools.description: Which topics or Series Into the Prompt is looking for creators to make, and how to apply. When the list is not public, it says how topics are shared and where to apply.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Into the Prompt's videos and series for a question. Returns a list of results, each with an id, a title and a link to open it on the Into the Prompt map; pass an id to fetch for the full record. For ChatGPT connectors, deep research and company knowledge.

query.description: A search query, in plain words

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one Into the Prompt record by the id a search returned: a video (its key, such as "rag-1-1"), a series ("series:rag") or the creator programme ("creator-program"). Returns its title, text, map link and details.
